lines.text: Isaiah calls the nations to listen, because the LORD is angry with all of them and will slaughter them.
The skies will be rolled up like a scroll, and the LORD's sword will come down upon Moab.
Edom's streams will turn to tar, and the desert owl and screech owl will possess the land.
Her towers will be overgrown with cedars, and in Edom the owl will make her nest and hatch her eggs.
